attributes.title: Which of the 16 types are you?
attributes.brief: Find which of the 16 personality types fits this person, using the four preference pairs: where they get their energy (other people, or time alone), what they notice first (concrete facts, or patterns and possibilities), how they decide (logic, or people and values), and how they like to live (planned, or open and flexible). For each pair, say which side they lean to and how sure we are, with evidence from what they said and did, in as few questions as we can. Give them their type with a short, specific explanation they would want to keep and share. This is for fun and self-reflection, not a diagnosis.
attributes.aims:
Energy: do they recharge with other people or with time alone?
Attention: do they notice concrete facts and details first, or patterns and possibilities?
Deciding: do they lean on logic and consistency, or on people and values?
Living: do they prefer things planned and settled, or open and flexible?
Give them a type and an explanation that feels true to them
attributes.mustAsk: Does the type feel right to them? What would they change about it?
